skills.name: Zetian Passive
skills.description: Unique passive ability for Zetian designed for competitive match viability.
skills.tips: Learn to manage passive triggers to dominate early game trades.

skills.name: Zetian Skill 1
skills.description: Deals damage and applies control or mobility modifiers.
skills.tips: Spam this skill to farm quickly and harass enemy laners.

skills.name: Zetian Skill 2
skills.description: Area control utility with slow/stun application.
skills.tips: Use this skill defensively or to setup ganks with allies.

skills.name: Zetian Ultimate
skills.description: High impact Ultimate ability turning the tide of teamfights.
skills.tips: Coordinate Ultimate activation with teammate crowd control set pieces.
